evidence.name: Screen field: Color of the field outline
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Color of the field outline" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Color of the field outline
sections.description: Sets the color of the field's outline, which only appears when the Border Style is an underline or a full box. Use a tone from your theme — an accent or a soft neutral — so the field's edges read clearly as something to tap and type into. A visible outline helps people recognize and fill in the field.
